data.name: Khushiyaarat
data.gender_notes: Khushiyaarat is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who brings happiness and joy to others. The name Khushiyaarat carries the meaning “Bringer of happiness and joy” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Khushiyaarat usually hope their child will grow to embody bringer of happiness and joy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A person who radiates positivity and happiness, spreading joy and cheer to those around them
data.etymology: Khushiyaarat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bringer of happiness and joy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khushiyaarat total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
